(i) the human brain is extremely efficient at object detection; (ii) this efficiency is due to selective attention; and (iii) this efficiency can be achieved in deep learning object detectors.

(1) selective attention can be efficiently implemented using a novel neural network architecture and (2) the proposed architecture achieves high object detection accuracy and high computational efficiency, thereby allowing for fast object detection on embedded devices such as drones.
